mapper.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN LENGTH(t.next_code) < 6 THEN LPAD(t.next_code, 6, '0') ELSE t.next_code END FROM ( SELECT CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(code AS NUMERIC)), 0) + 1 AS VARCHAR) AS next_code FROM products WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(code, '^[0-9]+$') ) t
